svg.title: Humanoid manipulation in a cluttered, stacked scene
svg.desc: A humanoid robot with a head, torso, two arms, and legs sorts three colored blocks from a stack surrounded by boxes, cylinders, and scattered parts. Its head follows the working hand while the other hand rests on the workbench. It identifies the top object, closes its articulated fingers, lifts above the clutter, and releases the object into a separate tray. Objects stay where they are placed. The return sequence rebuilds the stack for a seamless loop. Concept illustration.
